exposure: Interaction between IOL, AUG, and epidural
cohort: 386 women who gave birth (220 vaginal, 166 cesarean section)
finding: The incidence of atonic postpartum hemorrhage increased from 2015 to 2018, and in vaginal births, epidural analgesia, episiotomy, and induction of labor were associated with severe atonic PPH.
mod_finding: In a retrospective study in Saudi Arabia, epidural, episiotomy, and induction of labor (with or without augmentation) were associated with an increased risk of severe atonic postpartum hemorrhage in vaginal births.
